title: Detecting Covert Collusion between AI Agents through Partner-Outsider Positive Listening
abstract: arXiv:2610.37849v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents that share a secret convention can coordinate through messages that look innocent, so a monitor that reads only the messages can miss them. We propose a behavioural test: a partner that uses a code reacts to the exact wording of a message, whereas an uninvolved agent placed in its seat does not. Partner--Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is the difference between the two agents in how much their action changes when the message is reworded with its meaning kept, and it is computed after the fact by replaying logged prompts. In a simulated market with five conditions (no collusion, a joint reward with neutral messages, the same with an openly stated intention, a covert first-letter code, and the code with a stated intention), PoPLi is between 0.48 and 0.59 whenever the code is present (95% intervals all above 0.29) and between -0.10 and -0.01 without it. translated_title: 通过“伙伴-局外人正向聆听”检测AI智能体之间的隐蔽合谋
translated_abstract: 共享某种秘密约定的AI智能体可以通过看似无害的消息进行协调，因此仅读取消息内容的监控者可能会漏掉它们。我们提出一种行为测试：使用暗码的伙伴会对消息的确切措辞做出反应，而处于其位置的无关智能体则不会。“伙伴-局外人正向聆听”（PoPLi）衡量的是当消息在保持含义不变的情况下被改写时，两个智能体行动变化程度的差异，该方法在事后通过回放记录的提示来计算。在一个包含五种条件的模拟市场中（无合谋、带有中性消息的联合奖励、同样情况但公开声明意图、隐蔽的首字母暗码、以及带有声明意图的暗码），只要暗码存在，PoPLi就介于0.48到0.59之间（95%置信区间均高于0.29），而在没有暗码时则介于-0.10到-0.01之间。仅基于消息的监控器无法区分这些条件……
tldr: 本文提出PoPLi行为测试方法，通过比较真实伙伴与无关智能体在消息改写后行为变化程度的差异，能够检测出仅凭消息内容监控无法发现的AI智能体间隐蔽暗码合谋。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PoPLi (Partner-Outsider Positive Listening), a behavioral test that detects covert collusion between AI agents by measuring how much a partner's actions change when messages are reworded—revealing secret codes that message-only monitors fail to catch.
